sources: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/231860 (facility record, notices, rules, rate table, campsite catalog, availability May/Sept 2027)
https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp offices page (Sulphur Ranger District Office phone)

values.note: Single site $29 a night, double site $58 (recreation.gov 2026-2028 peak seasons). One vehicle included; extra vehicles $8 a night. An Arapaho National Recreation Area pass is also required: $5 for one day, $10 for three days, $15 for a week, $30 for a year (interagency passes accepted).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231860/rates (Peak 2026-05-15..09-19, 2027-05-14..09-18, 2028: STANDARD/RV NONELECTRIC 29, double 58) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/arapaho-bay-campground ('Single Site: $29 per night / Double Site: $58 per night') + recreation.gov notices (ANRA admission '$5 for one day, $10 for three days, $15 for a week or $30 for a year-long membership'; extra vehicle '$8.00 per vehicle per night') + status table ('Arapaho National Recreation Area pass required'), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: recreation.gov notice ('No RV water connections or utility hookups are available.') + campsite catalog for 231860 (all 79 sites NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Three loops: Big Rock (21), Moraine (28, shown as 'Mora') and Roaring Fork (30, of which 8 tent-only); 70 RV/standard sites plus 9 tent-only (the forest's status table says 84 sites). Catalog vehicle lengths 19-45 ft, mostly 25-35 ft, all back-in; the FS page gives spurs of 20-40 ft and the status table a 35-ft max. Some double sites. Little to no shade since beetle-kill tree removal.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 231860 (79 sites: BIG ROCK 21, MORA 28, ROARING FORK 30; 9 TENT ONLY; max vehicle length 19-45, Back-In) + facility record ('the campground offers little to no shade') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/arapaho-bay-campground ('The parking length ranges from 20 -40'') + status table ('84', '35’'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Drinking water in the Big Rock Loop only. Boat ramp; boats are inspected for mussels at Sunset Point before and after launching.

facilities.source: recreation.gov facility record ('Vault toilets, drinking water is available in the Big Rock Loop and trash collection are provided') + FS page ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site') + status table ('Boat ramp: Get inspected at Sunset Point before & after launching'), read 2026-10-26

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (campground status table, Arapaho Bay: 'May 15 - Sept 20'; FS page shows 'Site Closed' on 2026-10-26), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 64 sites are reservable on recreation.gov at least 4 days ahead, 7 nights at most; 15 sites (9 of them in the Moraine loop's RV group) are first-come only, and any site may go first-come in or out of the reservation season. A reserved site must be occupied within 26 hours; no site swapping. Dates are recreation.gov's 2027 Peak season (2026: May 15 - Sept 19).

booking.source: recreation.gov rules ('maxConsecutiveStay' 7, 'reservationCutOff' 4 day(s) prior to arrival) + availability May/Sept 2027 (15 sites 'Not Reservable' every day) + notices ('Sites may be available on a first-come, first-served basis during and outside the reservation season'; 'All campsites must be occupied within 26 hours'; 'Site-swapping is not allowed') + rate table Peak 2027-05-14..09-18, read 2026-10-26

note: Sulphur Ranger District, Arapaho National Recreation Area (Arapaho-Roosevelt NF), on Arapaho Bay at the east tip of Lake Granby, 9 mi up County Road 6 from US 34. The three loops sit along Roaring Fork Road (CR 637), which leaves CR 6 at the Big Rock Loop; CR 6 is gated at the campground. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov (record, rules, rates, catalog, availability) + FS page + status tables: confirmed $29 (double $58), no hookups, max 45 ft; added count 70 (+9 tent), back-in, vault toilets + Big Rock water, season May 15 - Sept 20, 180-day window, 4-day cutoff, 7-night max, some first-come sites, booking.season 05-14 - 09-18, ANRA pass in fees note. Note: dropped 'sites to ~45 ft' and 'Reservable online'. One campground: all three loops (0.6-1.4 km apart) are reached by one road, Roaring Fork Road off CR 6, so no split.
flags: Entry phone is empty. Sulphur Ranger District Office, 9 Ten Mile Drive, Granby: 970-295-6600 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp offices page; also on the campground page). recreation.gov's ANRA notice gives (970) 887-4100 for pass information and '(530) 529-0578' for facility-specific information.
Site-count conflict: the forest's status table says 84 sites (35' max spur); recreation.gov's catalog lists 79 (70 standard/RV + 9 tent-only). Count set to 70.
Pin is at the junction of CR 6 and Roaring Fork Road, 124 m from the Big Rock Loop centroid and 1.5 km from Roaring Fork Loop; fine for the campground as a whole.
